articles.title: Fed holds rates steady in first decision under new Chairman Kevin Warsh
articles.snippet: The accompanying policy statement and updated economic projections, however, took a hawkish turn.

articles.title: Kevin Warsh's first Fed meeting could be more about communication than rates
articles.snippet: While monetary policy is expected to remain unchanged, markets are focused on whether the new chair begins reshaping how the U.S. central bank communicates.

articles.title: Crypto PAC's $12 million Senate candidate, Barry Moore, wins Alabama GOP primary
articles.snippet: The Trump loyalist drew more crypto dollars than any candidate so far in this year's midterms, and the result marks a big win for the industry's political arm.

articles.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
articles.snippet: The Polymarket insider trading case and a retrial of Tornado Cash co-founder Roman Storm are expected to move forward in late 2026 while former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky awaits a response to his motion to vacate his sentence.

articles.title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
articles.snippet: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 19 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.
